purpose: Logged CONTEXT LABELS only. Never an entry rule, gate, sizing input or filter for Captain v3 or math-momentum. Paper/research only.

candle_6am.build_from: binance native 1m (all 240 bars required); fallback for pre-1m history: 4 binance native 1h bars (source labelled)
candle_6am.opposing_wick_definition: up candle -> upper wick; down candle -> lower wick (the wick pointing against the candle's direction)

session_profile.day_type_mapping: per the source post: London reversed Asia -> 'continuation_day' (trade London's direction); London did not reverse -> 'reversal_day'

fvg.formation_window: third candle starts within the prior calendar day (00:00-24:00 ET of D-1)
fvg.fill_rule: full: bullish gap filled once any later 1h low <= gap bottom; bearish once any later 1h high >= gap top (checked through 06:00 ET of D)

cross_asset.overnight_bars: Captain v3 primary 15m agg_1m bars, 00:00-06:00 ET, all required (same ONH/ONL as v3)
cross_asset.window: previous, trigger and next 15m bar around the event (+/-15 min); next bar makes the full label known at event+15m
cross_asset.beyond_rule: up: bar high > ONH*(1+tol); down: bar low < ONL*(1-tol)
